req.title: Logout clears session
req.statement: The system shall clear the session and redirect to / on GET /auth/logout.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session should be cleared and a redirect should occur when accessing the logout endpoint. Tests are designed to verify this behavior under normal, erroneous, and boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_logout_clears_session_positive
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in first
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Perform logout
r = client.get('/auth/logout')

# Check session is cleared and redirect
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_logout_without_login_negative
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Ensure no user is logged in
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Perform logout
r = client.get('/auth/logout')

# Check session is still cleared and redirect
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_logout_boundary_case
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in first
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Perform logout
r = client.get('/auth/logout')

# Check session is cleared and redirect
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Attempt to access a protected page
r = client.get('/create')

# Check redirect to login due to cleared session
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']
